items.title: JB said he doesn’t have timelines on Taurean Prince and Ebuka Okorie. Prince underwent knee surgery to take care of some “lingering” issues, he said. Okorie has a left oblique strain, and JB said the nature of it is one where they’ll just see how he progresses.

quote.author: Omari Sankofa II
quote.text:
Duncan Robinson (left quad strain), Ron Holland (left knee contusion/bone bruise) and Taurean Prince (right knee soreness) are all out vs the Spurs tomorrow with Jalen Duren. Pistons will be very shorthanded.

A little good news: Isaiah Joe has been upgraded to doubtful.
